name: EconWebArena
description: EconWebArena is a benchmark for evaluating autonomous agents on complex, multimodal economic tasks within realistic web environments. It includes 360 tasks from authoritative websites requiring navigation, interpretation of structured and visual content, and multi-step workflows to extract precise economic data.
reputation: A new benchmark for autonomous agents on realistic economic web tasks; still emerging and not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Emphasizes fidelity to authoritative data sources and grounded web-based economic reasoning.
